description: Mark a thread as read. Pass `threadIds` (a list of up to 100) instead of `threadId` to apply the same change to every listed thread in one call — for 'exactly these threads, as approved'. The answer then reports per thread: `changed`, `failed` (with code and message; the others still ran) and `notAttempted` (the run stopped at a rate limit, dead token or missing scope, which would have hit every remaining thread alike); `ok` is true only when all were changed. SIDE EFFECTS: removes UNREAD; reversible via mark_unread.
name: mark_read
